Unlock the Magic with MagicBands
MagicBands come in many shapes, colors and sizes. And the next generation, MagicBand+, has added
enhancements that allow you to engage with your park experience through color-changing lights, haptic
vibrations and gesture recognition. Please make your selection today or continue to check back as we improve
our selection.
